title: MQTT
description: Generic MQTT 3.1.1 broker client for widgets and wallpapers. Subscribe + publish over TCP, TLS, or WebSocket. Surface via iappyx.plugin('mqtt').*. Pure local-network by default — credentials never leave the device on a hostile network. Self-signed certs accepted for LAN brokers (Mosquitto on Raspberry Pi, Home Assistant's built-in broker, EMQX in a Docker container).
author: iappyx
